messages:
Ana: Heads-up, Cloudwatch alert: ~30 GPU nodes in us-west are flapping and pods failing with runtime loader errors :eyes:
Raj: seeing it too from node pool autoscaler metrics, spike in OOM/kubelet restarts? any logs?
Ana: example from one node:
```
failed to load /usr/lib/libnvidia-ml.so.1: No such file or directory
Error opening /usr/lib/libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
container runtime: mount failed: invalid mount config for device "/run/nvidia": permission denied
```
Mei: that looks like the nvidia-container-toolkit bind mounts not propagating into container mount namespace. we just rolled toolkit 1.12 -> 1.14 in the shared base image this morning in us-west-2 canary.
Lucas: only us-west-2? any other regions reporting?
Ana: I searched logs cluster-wide, only us-west-2 and one us-west-1 AZ spike. europe/us-east normal.
James: paging infra @Raj oncall, adding deploy-bot canary summary
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-18T09:12:14Z base-image-toolkit:1.14 -> passed in eu-west, failed in us-west-2 (3/10 hosts)
Raj: hmm that suggests host kernel or driver mismatch interacting with toolkit mount propagation. kernel versions on affected nodes: 5.15.0-1129 vs 5.19 on healthy ones.
Mei: toolkit 1.14 changed how it sets rshared on mounts by default; a known edge case if host containerd has certain mount propagation settings. it can cause libcuda symlinks not to be visible inside container.
Ana: repro steps I ran on a bad node:
```
# ls /run/nvidia
libnvidia-ml.so -> missing
# docker run --rm --gpus all ubuntu:20.04 ls -l /usr/lib | grep cuda || true
# strace shows open("/usr/lib/libcuda.so.1", O_RDONLY) = -1 ENOENT
```
Raj: quick mitigation: rollback base-image-toolkit to 1.12 for us-west-2 canary and cordon affected nodes then drain and reprovision with pinned image. can we push that?
Lucas: agree. also as temporary workaround, we can set the nvidia mountbind to use explicit `--mount-propagation=rshared` on the kubelet host mounts, but that's cluster-level change. risky.
Mei: I can build a hotfix image that reverts the mount namespace tweak and push to our private repo. should be quick.
Ana: ops checklist so far: 1) cordon impacted nodes (us-west-2) 2) rollback base image -> 1.12 for pods 3) repro on repro-node and collect strace+mountinfo 4) open driver/toolkit bug with vendor with logs and kernel version matrix
James: I'll start cordoning/evicting pods from the worst nodes. tagging oncall: @Raj.
Raj: thanks. also capture whether affected kernels have CONFIG_NAMESPACES or userns differences, and whether we saw any recent host upgrades that day.
Mei: filing a PR with the rollback image and adding a canary throttle (5% -> 0) now. pushing notes to #eng-infra.
Ana: leaving notes for customer-facing status: small subset of compute jobs failing in us-west-2, mitigations in progress.
Lucas: postmortem actions to consider: add kernel-driver compatibility matrix to our release checklist, add mount-propagation test to canary pipeline, and pin toolkit + driver combinations per region until we have automated regression tests.
Mei: also we should add an automated check that inspects `/proc/self/mountinfo` after runtime starts to ensure libcuda path is visible inside a minimal container. I'll throw that into the canary smoke test.
Ana: good. thanks all. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
Mei: update 12m: rollback image pushed, canary stopped, failing node count dropping from 32 -> 6. collecting final logs for vendor ticket.
Raj: update 25m: cordoned 14 nodes, draining 10, repro nodes captured strace+mountinfo, sending artifacts to 
`https://artifacts.internal/redwood/sre/1912345678/`
Ana: closing loop once all nodes reprovisioned. if anyone sees new region flaps ping here.
